correctness.rationale: Exact congruence identifies a degree-four coordinate-squaring pullback of a uniquely nodal cubic; parity valuations of two square classes at three distinct coordinate intersections imply geometric integrality. The complete Jacobian stratification produces exactly four full-support nondegenerate nonsplit nodes and six coordinate cusps with exact local equation U^2+2V^3. Their total delta=10 yields rational normalization; branchwise Frobenius on four nonsplit nodes determines all-extension counts and zeta. The packaged standard-library checker verifies polynomial identity, both small-field counts and critical local discriminants; enumeration does not substitute for geometric proof.

originality.rationale: The original genus-six model and characteristic-five rationality are already established in Edge/Inoue--Kato and Giulietti et al., respectively. The final claim only credits new refined local and arithmetic data: six cusps, four nonsplit nodes, Jacobian length 16 and exact nonnormal zeta correction. value.rationale: The coefficientwise bad-prime fibre of a distinguished symmetric genus-six curve is a natural arithmetic object. Its complete singularity basket and nonsplit branches resolve model-specific zeta data that geometric rationality cannot determine. The local and arithmetic classification is a motivated exact refinement, not arbitrary finite enumeration; it identifies a six-cusp jump and all-extension field count. No stable reduction or generic Jacobian conductor is inferred.
